name: release
description: The release board's domain: services, environments, deployments, incidents and the event log, kept as JSON in the app's data home; promotions, rollbacks and incident changes run through it.
mount: a row `- id: release` / `name: release` before the page rows in blend.yaml; a page injects the `release` service

config.file: the JSON file, relative to the app's home (default deploy-board.json)
config.clock: what time it is, for tests
config.newId: how ids are made, for tests
